newsitem.title: USA: Mallinckrodt, Hercules sell Tastemaker venture.
newsitem.headline: Mallinckrodt, Hercules sell Tastemaker venture.

text.p: Mallinckrodt Inc and Hercules Inc said Wednesday they had agreed to sell their 50-50 Tastemaker partnership to Roche Holding Ltd .
Tastemaker, based in Cincinnati, Ohio, makes and sells flavor compounds, citrus specialties and process flavors for the food and beverage industries.
In a separate statement, Mallinckrodt said the deal is expected to have a net value to it of about $550 million, which includes an exchange of stock and debt assumption.

Mallinckrodt said that during the next 18 months it will make incremental share repurchases of up to $250 million. It said the repurchases will be in addition to previously announced buyback programs.
"We want our shareholders to benefit from the value created by the partners with the Tastemaker joint venture," Mallinckrodt Chairman C. Ray Holman said in a statement.

He said the transaction is in line with Mallinckrodt's announcement last August that it would divest Tastemaker and its animal health business and would focus and expand its core businesses in human health care and specialty chemicals.
"For Tastemaker, we are delighted that the new owner is such an excellent strategic fit," Holman said. "That business is well-positioned to realize its full potential."
Mallinckrodt said its financial results will be restated to reflect Tastemaker and related assets as discontinued operations, effective with the recently closed second quarter.
